text: dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit 为 DSH 提供图像理解命令，面向需要让文本型 agent 读取截图或图片的场景。插件向系统提示词注入 vision-tools 技能说明，并提供 glance、ground、detect 和 crop 命令：可描述图片、回答图片问题、提取文字、定位指定元素、列出同类元素并裁剪区域。图像分析会将本地图片编码后发送到兼容 OpenAI 格式的视觉 API；使用前需配置 VISION_API_KEY 或 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY。裁剪功能还依赖可选的 sharp。

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit gives text based agents image tools. glance describes images, answers questions, and extracts text; ground locates an element; detect lists matches; crop saves a region. An injected skill teaches command use. Images go to a configured vision API; crop needs optional sharp.
想让文本型 agent 看懂截图并用文字说明画面内容
帮我从图片里识别所有可见文字，尽量保留原文
我想问截图里显示了什么错误信息
让 DSH 根据图片找到某个按钮并给出它的位置
I need an agent to describe a screenshot and answer questions about what it shows.
Find every button or text field in an image and report their locations.
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit 的图片描述与问答功能：glance <图片> 可生成画面描述，添加 -q 和问题可针对图片提问，添加 --ocr 可提取可见文字。
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit 的元素定位功能：ground <图片> <目标描述> 会请求视觉模型查找指定元素，并返回 0 到 1000 坐标网格上的边界框；找不到时返回 NOT_FOUND。
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit 的批量检测功能：detect <图片> <元素类型> 会查找所有匹配元素，并逐行返回每个元素的边界框和简短描述。
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit 的区域裁剪功能：crop <输入图片> X1,Y1,X2,Y2 <输出图片> 按 0 到 1000 的坐标网格裁切区域并保存；该命令需要 sharp。
Images and prompts are sent to the configured vision API, which defaults to api.deepseek.com; an API key is required.
Need to read text from a screenshot and preserve what it says?
Can I cut out one region of an image and save it separately?
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit：Vision toolkit for DeepSeek Harness -- give text-only agents the ability to see images.

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · What it does：Provides CLI tools that call a vision API (DeepSeek VL, GPT-4V, or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) to describe, locate, detect, and crop elements from images. Registered as a dsh skill so agents know when and how to use them.

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Tools：- `glance` -- describe, ask about, or OCR an image
- `ground` -- locate a specific element (returns bounding box)
- `detect` -- find all instances of an element kind
- `crop` -- cut a region from an image

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile your-profile add dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit
```
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Usage examples：```bash
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Describe an image：glance screenshot.png
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Ask a question：glance screenshot.png -q "What error is shown?"
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · OCR：glance screenshot.png --ocr
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Find a button：ground screenshot.png "the login button"
dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Find all buttons：detect screenshot.png "buttons"

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Crop a region：crop screenshot.png 450,820,620,870 button.png
```

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · How it works：The plugin registers a skill in the system prompt that teaches the agent about the vision tools. When the agent encounters an image (user pastes one, references a screenshot, etc.), it calls the appropriate CLI tool which:

1. Reads the image file
2. Encodes it as base64
3. Sends it to the vision API with a prompt
4. Returns the text response

The agent never sees raw pixels -- it gets text descriptions it can reason about.

dsh-plugin-vision-toolkit README · Supported vision providers：- DeepSeek VL (deepseek-vl2, deepseek-vl2.5)
- OpenAI GPT-4V / GPT-4o
- Any OpenAI-compatible multimodal endpoint
